annotations.title: EVE Frontier Lagrange Node Siege Capacitor Depletion Simulator

description: Simulates Lagrange Network Node gigajoule (GJ) capacitor drain under sustained hostile fleet siege and computes optimal assembly load-shedding order. Use when preparing base defense power-shedding schedules against an incoming hostile fleet; for calculating routine peacetime fuel burn and reserve headroom, use optimize_eve_node_power instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'node_id' ('siege_intensity' defaults to 'skirmish_frigate_squad'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

node_id.description: Target Lagrange Network Node identifier under siege simulation.

siege_intensity.description: Hostile fleet DPS and electronic-warfare drain tier; defaults to 'heavy_cruiser_wing' when omitted.

name: simulate_eve_capacitor_siege

capacitor_survival_minutes.description: Minutes before capacitor reserves drop below turret firing threshold.

load_shedding_sequence.description: Ordered list of non-essential assemblies to power down first.
